sections: New

Rewind, your view like a live recording (Prism): games recorded with dev.100 or later now play back with your hand and swings, block breaking and placing, your own sounds, F5/F1/F3/Tab, inventory, chest and shop screens with the cursor, chat typing, your exact FOV and aim, and your Cobblify HUD as it looked in the game.
Rewind: watch from another player's view, and a Clean View Key hides the viewer bar.
Fixes
Rewind: no more see-through armor stands or small dragons over chests and shopkeepers, and the hotbar no longer falls behind after buying from a shop.
New

Rewind recorder upgrade (Prism): new recordings also save what you did yourself: block breaking and placing, your own sounds, F5/F1/F3/Tab, inventory and chest screens with the cursor, chat typing, exact FOV, your skin, and what your Cobblify HUD showed. Watching looks the same as dev.96 for now; the next build uses the new data. Recordings made from this build on cannot be opened by dev.95 or dev.96.
Fixes

Rewind: the last moment of a game now plays, old items no longer linger in the hotbar after a respawn, Watch Last Game shows with Record Games off, and Hypixel replay-viewer sessions are no longer kept as games.
New

Rewind, step 2 of 4 (Prism): watch your recorded games. Open Rewind from the title screen or the Esc menu, pick a game, and it plays back from your own view with your hand, hotbar and hearts. Pause, change speed, skip 5 seconds, jump between markers (bed breaks, final kills, your Marker Key) on the timeline, or switch to a free camera. Games recorded with dev.95 work.
New

Rewind, step 1 of 4 (Prism): Cobblify now records every game in the background. Nothing can be watched yet; watching comes in the next step. The last 10 games are kept in the Rewind folder. Settings > Hypixel > Rewind has Record Games, a Marker Key, and Open Folder.
New

Motion Blur (Prism): the world blurs along the direction you turn the camera. Your held item, the HUD and menus stay sharp. One Strength slider. Off by default. If you also use PolyBlur, turn one of them off.
New
Fullbright (Prism): full brightness with a fade and an optional toggle key. Off by default.
Item Physics (Prism): dropped items lie flat and tumble as they fall. Off by default.
1.7 Animations (Prism): Block Hit, Item Position, Smooth Sneak, Hearts and Red Armor. Off by default.
Particles (Prism): always show crits, hide your own potion swirls, hide block-break particles, and a 1x to 3x crit multiplier. Off by default.
Fixes
What's New on a dev build shows only what's new since the version you had.
New

Prism runs Cobblify on Ornithe with Java 25 and the Pylon, Argentum and Sarcio performance mods (plus Slipstream on macOS), in a new instance that copies your Forge instance's settings, packs and servers.
Zoom (hold C) and No Hurt Cam on Prism.
Clutch Practice works on Prism too.
Fixes
Session Stats no longer reset when Hypixel moves you between servers.
New
Clutch Practice (Forge, singleplayer): throwable fireballs for pearl and fireball clutches, with unlimited items and a void reset.
Bed Alert and BG Alert: a sound when a teammate or your party calls bed or bg in a Bed Wars game, each with its own sound.
Quit Lunar after launch: a launcher setting that closes Lunar's launcher once Cobblify loads in game. Off by default.
New
A new app icon: a Bed Wars island with a red bed. On macOS 26 it follows light and dark mode.
Changes
On macOS the native title bar matches the window, and hides in full screen.
Settings sits beside Launch at the same height. The version and release notes are in Settings.
The stats board shows the Dev builds tag too.
Fixes
On macOS, Settings extends to the top of the window while the home title stays below the window buttons.
On macOS, the home title returns below the window buttons after leaving full screen.
On macOS 26 the window and its buttons look like every other app's.
Windows shows the new icon in the taskbar and Start menu right after updating.
New
A new launcher, built like the in-game menu: one Launch button that remembers Lunar or Prism, and settings in a side sheet.
The stats board is drawn like Bed Wars' sidebar: one line per player, sized to your window.
What's New shows the changes once after each update.
The launcher follows the accent colour and font you picked in game.
Updates download by themselves until you turn Auto-update off.
Changes
The Minecraft font and Pale Blue are now the in-game default look.
Session Stats draws on top of everything; Session Stats and Map Info hide when you're not on Hypixel.
Seraph closed its API, so cheater tags now come from Urchin only.
New
Right Shift opens a new settings sheet, with search and 39 accent colours.
Edit HUD edits in place: snapping, corner resize, undo and a right-click menu.
A Minecraft font option for the menu and every HUD module.
Keystrokes shows clicks per second for both mouse buttons.
Fixes
On Lunar, Right Shift no longer opens and closes the menu at once.
Updates remove old Cobblify jars from Lunar and Prism.
Fixes
Lunar: the key that opens the settings sheet no longer closes it.
Fixes
Session Stats keeps counting after a disconnect.
Queue chat alerts trust only real queue messages.
